drhp.business: The Company is engaged in the gems and jewellery business, with manufacturing operations specialising in handmade gold jewellery studded with precious and semi-precious natural gemstones, flat diamonds, rose-cut diamonds, diamonds and cubic zirconia. Its business model centres on combining manufacturing capabilities, product development, market relationships and distribution opportunities to serve evolving customer requirements across different jewellery categories. Products are sold across domestic and overseas markets, historically concentrated in the business-to-business (B2B) segment.
drhp.expansion: The Company's integrated manufacturing facility at Hyderabad currently has an installed capacity of 125 kg per month, against which capacity utilisation stands at a modest level, leaving headroom for scaling production. risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Fluctuations in gold and other precious-metal prices can influence jewellery prices, consumer demand, inventory values and working-capital requirements.
- Jewellery demand can be influenced by economic conditions, disposable income, consumer confidence, seasonal factors and changing preferences.
- The jewellery sector is highly competitive, with organised and established players competing across product quality, design, pricing, customer experience and distribution.
- The jewellery industry operates within a framework of applicable laws, regulations and standards relating to business operations, taxation, hallmarking, corporate governance and financial reporting.
- Following the acquisition of Sanghi Jewellers Private Limited's business and the amalgamation of Narbada Gems and Jewellery Limited, effective integration of people, processes, systems and operations remains important; management is focused on achieving expected synergies while maintaining governance and financial controls.
- The Company is exposed to the risk of price fluctuation in respect of raw materials as well as finished goods, managed through forward booking and prudent inventory management practices.
